bounds.scope: future runner enforcement; the static fixture checker validates only the declaration shape and finite values

command.executable_resolution: explicit placeholder; resolve <jmeter-home> and <java-home> from the runner manifest; do not resolve either executable through inherited PATH
command.working_directory_scope: the future harness must resolve <case-root> to the repository-relative case directory and chdir there before resolving every relative input

working_directory_requirements.path_separator: use the target OS separator after resolving the repository-relative case directory; do not rewrite fixture-relative paths in the argv templates

implicit_property_lookup.initial_file: the file selected by -p in each argv template
implicit_property_lookup.missing_behavior: fail fixture setup; do not silently substitute ambient user.properties or system.properties

command.environment_policy: inherit no ambient variables; configure and record locale, timezone, charset, Java, and JMeter home explicitly

locale_evidence.verification: record the effective JVM locale and the launcher environment at oracle execution; this static manifest does not infer observation from the requested value

locale_materialization.portable_contract: materialize the profile locale as an installed target-OS locale with an explicit UTF-8 codeset; on POSIX a valid example is en_US.UTF-8 and on Windows a valid example is en-US
locale_materialization.unavailable_behavior: fail fixture setup or evidence promotion; do not silently fall back to C/POSIX or an uninstalled locale alias
locale_materialization.verification: record the exact materialized locale environment and JVM default locale for every future run

charset_evidence.property_file_decoder: ISO-8859-1 via Java Properties.load(InputStream), independent of the requested default charset
charset_evidence.verification: record JVM file.encoding/default charset and retain the literal UTF-8 property probe; do not rewrite source bytes or fabricate its decoded value

observation.missing_behavior: fail evidence promotion; do not infer either observed value from command.default_charset or environment requests

jvm_requirements.verification: a future runner must record the effective JVM file.encoding and Charset.defaultCharset().name() before comparing any projection

limitations: This checked-in corpus is a deterministic input and static expectation only; Java/JMeter execution is intentionally pending.
process_exit and sample_count are null because no oracle process ran; neither is an assertion, and no log text or JTL bytes are claimed.

The expectation asserts fixture-owned property scopes, parser edge cases, and documented load order. Ambient JVM properties, host identity, startup timestamps, and unobserved locale/charset values are not part of the expected set.

CFG-003 coverage is limited to an explicit case-root working directory, literal UTF-8 source bytes, UTF-8 JMX metadata, escaped property values, requested profile locale en-US, requested profile timezone UTC, and the profile's empty environment allowlist. Locale/default-charset observations are pending; the Linux/Windows/macOS target-triple matrix, launcher/JVM resolution, path-separator matrix, and OS-specific filesystem behavior remain harness gaps.
The -G vectors are only static remote-property merge projections: without a remote worker run, those values are unobservable and are not asserted as local Debug Sampler output.
The attached and separate -G file/key-value forms are intentional coverage. A future runner must report an option-parser gap rather than deleting, rewriting, or weakening these vectors.
The implicit user.properties and system.properties paths are fixture requirements resolved from each initial -p file; ambient files outside the declared lookup roots are out of scope.
The fixture covers configuration-affecting CLI options named by CFG-001; it does not claim complete CLI option, usage-text, report, or process-exit compatibility.
